data.action: 手执荧光鸡尾酒杯靠在琉璃吧台旁，高开叉长裙展现修长美腿，眼神敏锐侦查
data.camera: medium shot, cowboy perspective, elegant fashion framing
data.description: 【露西 · 云顶俱乐部的幻彩鸡尾酒】夜之城顶级云顶俱乐部顶层空中花园，水幕与全息锦鲤在身边穿梭。露西身穿闪烁着幻彩偏光的银灰高开叉吊带晚礼服，指尖捏着一杯冒着荧光烟雾的马天尼。她假装漫不经心地倚在吧台边观察着荒坂高层的动向，优雅高贵却暗藏致命杀机。
data.lighting: 水幕反射的荧光粉紫霓虹与奢华金箔吧台柔和光影
data.location: 云顶高空奢华俱乐部露天水榭
data.promptProse: At the rooftop club garden bar, Lucy holds a vaporous fluorescent martini in her iridescent silver-gray slip dress, quietly watching Arasaka executives beyond the water curtain. Holographic koi pass beside her in the medium cowboy view. Cyan-magenta neon reflected through the moving water colors the dress and glass, while softer light from the gold-leaf bar catches her fingertips and choker against the darker skyline.
data.title: 露西 · 云顶俱乐部的幻彩鸡尾酒
